list.comment:
twenty-sixth commit (Technically version 0.1, pre-release) * added progression system (eventmanager) and battle creation (guess which file...) * added dialog events (huge gem alert!) * added in some encounters (I WILL ABOLISH THIS LATER, not the system duh, just change it completely)

task.summary: Default task
First commit
Second commit * created base for the pygame display - need to create fundamental files that store parts of the game
Third commit * created module to extract sprites - going to start building fundamental files that store parts of the game and interactable buttons
Third commit * created module to extract sprites - going to start building fundamental files that store parts of the game and interactable buttons
Fourth commit * fixed sprite sizes and flipped enemy sprites
Fifth commit * Added a to do list
seventh commit * made functioning buttons that effect the state of the game -note- needed alot of help with this part from artificial intelligence I think I understand most of it though :)
eighth commit * made buttons better looking -note- made hover effect and outlines (plus accessibility for future buttons like inventory)

ninth commit * implemented panels that can show typewriter text * added locking capability to buttons for later gameplay options -note- the text is still kinda weird and ai had to rewrite most of the text to make it work

tenth commit * big stuff happened * optimized images.py to flip more images * optimized image files to not turn blurry when upscaling * created a layout for both the intro part of the game and started on the battle and main game layout -note- - still need to polish stuff - this is turning quite big and my programs are already kinda sad, unsure if this can even run on trinket pygame - still need to make layout for shop and inventory plus character select screen

eleventh commit * small but useful * created ui for CharcaterPicker() * made buttons that effect other things than the current state (good for battles later -note- - Check to do for what I still need to make - I am at a bit of a crossroads where I have several things to make but unsure what is smartest (I really don't wanna make the character and enemy classes :( )

eleventh commit * small but useful * created ui for CharcaterPicker() * made buttons that effect other things than the current state (good for battles later -note- - same commit, just forgot to do list

twelfth commit * added sounds! * now all buttons that are unlocked have hover and press sounds * changed colors for character select screen so each character has unique colors, will save color to make battle screen more personal -note- - the ui and sound systems are looking good now, takes a long time to make it look good tbh - will implement background sounds later, updated to do :(

thirteenth commit * fixed a bit with character select panels (color fix) * added entity_classes.py which stores both character- and attack classes (I have officially lost the plot man) * -note- - This project has now become: 1. I lack feature, 2. I lack knowledge of how to add it, 3. I ask chat, 4. I spend an hour finetuning, 5. repeat - next up is the battle loop system - added create text on button hover to to do

fourteenth commit * worked on the worst things, backend battle stuff, check notes * added inventory, items work as attacks * entity classes are kinda done, the blueprints for attacks and such is done * added effects to the game like freeze, burn and poison
-note- - gotta be honest here, ive worked hand in hand with chat here for god knows how many hours (maybe 7-8) and now the only one who knows how it works is chat. - for every one thing I implement I think about two new things that are needed, My longing for when this gets done is growing by the minute - I havent even studied for my upcoming, more important, tests :(

sixteenth commit * added a game over screen * added total_X stats to track stuff
-note- - nothin'

seventeenth commit (structure changes) * added icons for future attacks and effects * added panel_on_hover for descriptions and stuff (needs work) * fixed folder and file layouts for fewer headaches (big) * added new backgrounds for upcoming events and such
-note- - I needed the ui to feel more alive and the buttons need to be clean and small so a large description window was absolutely needed (for about every button that is to be used) - backend needed better structure, I think stuff works, but I am unsure (sadge) - I am still building the battle system (nothing works yet because ui is not fully built and structure problems are everywhere in battle_loop)

nineteenth commit * modified attack system
-note- - I will add like 2 more status effects and then ill actually start making all the attacks

nineteenth* commit * added lifesteal, and a base for conditional effects
-note- - will start on ALL attacks now

twenty-first commit * added env-sounds for dialog events * added sfx for battles * added theme sound and battle music
-note- - Im not using these right now, but they will prolly be used later

twenty-second commit * added actual character stats * fixed attack stat (now in dmg-calc with scaling)
-note- - finna make the enemies now - will prolly need to add more attacks :(

twenty-third commit * added a bunch of enemies
-note- - not done, its kind of boring to do this

twenty-fourth commit * I am unsure about what i added this commit * Added battle ui with modes: like main and attack (prolly gonna use it for dialog later as well) * fixed buttons not working (connected to next button)
-note- - I have been working on this for about a day now... That being said, the battle system actually works now (its a bit wonky tho) - rn effect damage does damage twice per turn (i dont have the time rn to fix) - will fix up battle a bit and maybe fix dialog and progression system if i have the time

twenty-fifth commit * fixed up battle ui a bit (icons implemented and such) * some backend logic fixed, a mess rn
-note- - I am trying to rush completion due to deadline coming up - will try to add progression system and dialog mode for ui - if i have time i will add in my panel_on_hover, prolly wont have time though :(
